description: PolicyService defines the contract for policy-related operations such as creating policies, updating premiums, and searching policies by code or type within the insurance management system.

classes.name: PolicyService
classes.description: A Java interface specifying available operations for managing insurance policy products.

methods.name: createPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new insurance policy with specified code, name, type, and base premium.

methods.name: updatePremium
methods.description: Updates the base premium for an existing policy identified by its ID.

methods.name: findByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a policy matching the given code, if it exists.

methods.name: findByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of policies matching the specified policy type.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all policies.
